correctness.rationale: Direct character orthogonality proves the necessary and sufficient image-space condition and exact phase; the transpose under trace is −ad_C. Rational-canonical classification and the endomorphism-ring unit formula establish the all-n coefficient extraction. A complete classification of noncyclic three-square matrices gives N5. Sharp extremizers are scalar and cyclic matrices. The embedded checker exhausts q=2,3 for 3-by-3 adjoint ranks and independently verifies exact formal coefficients at q=2,3,4 and direct small-size Fourier sums. Unproved limits are distinguished from the universal proof.

value.rationale: The commutator graph is a canonical nonlinear translation-invariant incidence set. Complete Fourier support describes all observable and null Fourier modes, and the explicit centralizer Euler product computes all positive singular-value multiplicities for every n. The sharp all-dimensional condition number and nontrivial three-level 3-by-3 census are mathematically natural spectral invariants. The claim is not just an arbitrary numerical recomputation; the proof provides a uniform conceptual mechanism and calculation for all field orders.
